messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: integer-program feasibility for a fixed minimum-area threshold

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "An integer-program feasibility model encoding a fixed minimum-area threshold of 1/165 for 13 points in the unit square, using a 60x60 grid with area formulas scaled by 360000 to become integer constraints, is feasible, establishing a lower bound strictly exceeding 1/168. The IP enforces that each candidate grid point either is or is not selected via a binary variable, with constraints requiring that no three selected points form a triangle of scaled area below 2400. Feasibility of this IP would immediately produce an explicit 13-point configuration whose minimum triangle area is at least 1/165, improving on the best known constructions."}
